title.narrative: Support to Health professionals Licensing Exam Administration and Development (health-LEAD) in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to improve quality of the health service and protect the public through standardized assessment of service delivery systems. Specifically, it aims to build national capacities to assess competency of graduates before licensing them as health care workers.
